test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Misa is married to Light. Light's elder brother Yagami has two daughters and no son, Shina being the younger of the two. Mikasa is Shina's paternal grandmother. Mikasa has a grandson Oshio. Yagami's mother-in-law has an only child. Mikasa has only two children and Misa is Mikasa's daughter-in-law. How is Light related to Oshio?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) Light's elder brother Yagami has two daughters and no son, Shina being the younger of the two.

2) Mikasa is Shina's paternal grandmother.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7cd87ddfdb2d8a78dcfac621850be67d68a699c13e087be30ee6fa4be270ee3.png] 

3) Mikasa has only two children and Misa is Mikasa's daughter-in-law. 

4) Misa is married to Light.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8c3e5a858565909827f96d2d8a1ebd194c4f30acd7c93197ca37c72916385dd.png] 

5) Mikasa has a grandson Oshio.

6 Yagami's mother-in-law has an only child.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1235bb330adc147d936494454fc5236925fa26812b8c4e2cd7ea55ed05329db6.png] 

Thus, Light is Oshio's father's.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
